summary: Bound owner-local PEEK observation by explicit selected-use and revocable leases

rules.detail: RULES_VERSION remains11; no checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: PEEK expires after60seconds idle or300seconds absolute. Output is not renewal. Authority revocation cancels observations before writer acknowledgement. ATTACH is unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption beyond a normal daemon upgrade.

manual.detail: Consumers must renew only foreground-selected PEEK observations, rotate with fresh acquisition and GEOMETRY plus SCREEN readiness, and reacquire after EOF.

recovery.detail: No data rewrite or destructive migration; existing binary swap-back behavior is unchanged. Older builds retain their older observation enforcement.
